category_summary:
**Launch of the week — Bot Screen / desktop passthrough in Hermes Desktop:** The official **NousResearch** [announcement of **Bot Screen**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-ef6b4179c4fa) (real-time streaming of any agent's browser or terminal session) was the top post of the batch, with **Teknium**'s companion [reveal of the interactive desktop passthrough](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-4784626f2a61) — visually and interactively accessing the same machine your **Hermes Agent** works on — pulling 1,148+ likes. **@tonbistudio**'s [walkthrough video and docs](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d84a2bc0a85d) were amplified by both **NousResearch** (544 likes, ~46k views) and [**Teknium**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d03d44ef66a9), making this feature the undisputed center of attention.

**Community OSS — oh-my-hermes & Jev ecosystem:** **rlaope** [open-sourced **jeval**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-99948938337f) (Jev evaluation/visualization) and shipped [**oh-my-hermes** support for **Jev-Skills** and **model routing**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-415aecf318f8) (Jev models/aliases, skills/plugins, workflows), positioning OMH as the [all-in-one plugin for hermes-agent power users](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-b4d141253a4f) — the strongest original-contribution thread of the period.

**Maintainer engagement & official support:** **Teknium** directly [rebutted a reported cache problem](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d5a2f794eeec) (demanding reproducible issue-tracker paths, signaling thorough testing) and confirmed a rapid fix, while **NousResearch** [dispensed a practical usage tip](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-768697783517) (**Hermes** via **iMessage** with any model, 121 likes) and **Teknium** [corrected a public misattribution](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-992950038a21), clarifying the work in question is built by **Nous Research**, not Anthropic.

**Sentiment:** Overwhelmingly positive and long-awaited — **Teknium**'s ["Much needed!"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-48968e1c836e) (202 likes, ~20k views) and ["Impressive!"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-015fe011793b) endorsement captured launch enthusiasm. Remaining posts ([emoji-only replies](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-486ebb464590), [bare link reposts](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-119341252aeb), [engagement-bait prompts](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-921e5927b0af), vague [Opus 5.5/Claude Code takes](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-797e0ee6c95e)) carried little informational value and were excluded from the ranking.

items.title: You can now watch your agents work live as Hermes Desktop streams the screen of any bot's screen or ...
items.content:
You can now watch your agents work live as Hermes Desktop streams the screen of any bot's screen or session in real time. 

Watch it drive a browser, type into a terminal, or open a window. Take over anytime to interact with the Bot Screen or type credentials and seamlessly hand back off when you're done.
